card.title: How To Repair PS4 Overheating
symptoms: shuts down with too hot message

claims.statement: Most PS4 overheating is a dust-packed heatsink, a failing fan, or dry thermal paste.
Fans that click, hesitate or don't spin at boot have worn bearings or a fault; each model (Fat, Slim, Pro) uses a different fan connector.
After cleaning and repasting, tighten heatsink pressure screws in an X pattern and run a game 20–30 minutes to verify.

procedure: Disassemble, clean fan, vents and heatsink fins.
Replace thermal paste; reinstall heatsink in X pattern.
Replace fan if dead; stress test 20–30 minutes.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
